title: Lubbuu Jalqabaa Dhaabbatte
intro: Ergamaan kamiyyuu lafa irra osoo hin deemin yeroo dheeraa dura, macaafni kamiyyuu osoo hin mul’atin dura, uumamni kan biroo irraa adda ta’e tokko uumame. Lubbuun kun harka waaqaatiin bocamtee, bakki bareedina wal hin madaalle kennameefii, seenaa dhala namaa hundumaa keessatti haala sagalee ta’een qoratamte. Wanti itti aanee dhufe seenaa dadhabina, gaabbii garaa garaa fi hiree adeemsa uumaa bara baraan jijjiiru ture. Kun eenyu akka ta'e tilmaamu dandeessu?
clues: Biyyee lafaa keessaa harka Rahmata godheen bocame
Manni bareedina gita hin qabne, bakka beelli ykn dadhabbiin tokkollee na tuquu hin dandeenye naaf kenname
Muka tokkottillee gonkumaa akkan hin dhiyaanne ajajameera, sababiin isaas haraama waan ta’eef
Aniifi hiriyaan koo gowwoomfamnee muka haraamaatti dhiyaanne, ajaja Gooftaa keenyaa malee
Towbaa garaa qulqulluudhaan gara Gooftaa keenyaatti deebine, irra daddarbaan keenyas dhiifama nuuf godhame
Nurraa dhala namaa hunduu bu’e; Ani nama jalqaba lafa kanarra deemedha

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Kunuunsa dhala namaa isa jalqabaa ta'ee gara lafaatti gadi ergame
Fara’oonii fi waraanni isaa galaana keessatti liqimfaman
Bishaan badiisaa guddaan sun namoota jalʼoota ni balleesse
outcome.answer: Kunuunsa dhala namaa isa jalqabaa ta'ee gara lafaatti gadi ergame

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
